chansons.style: Modern reggaeton latin pop, 92 BPM, heavy dembow rhythm, nylon guitar, smooth male vocal, dreamy party vibe, deep bass, warm synth pads.

[Pre-Chorus]

In this magic, we are deep

[Chorus]
Dreamscape, dreamscape, moving so fast
Leave the worries in the past
Dreamscape, dreamscape, under the moon
We will be together soon

[Verse 2]
Silver stars are spinning round
Lost inside this magic sound
Every whisper is a song
In this dream is where we belong
Feel the fire in your soul
Let the rhythm take control

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold my hand and take a leap
In this magic, we are deep

[Chorus]
Dreamscape, dreamscape, moving so fast
Leave the worries in the past
Dreamscape, dreamscape, under the moon
We will be together soon

[Bridge]
Wake me up or let me sleep
Promises we swore to keep

[Chorus]
Dreamscape, dreamscape, moving so fast
Leave the worries in the past
Dreamscape, dreamscape, under the moon
We will be together soon

[Outro]
Floating high, touching the sky
Dreamscape, never say goodbye

C'est notre magie, c'est notre ruse

[Pre-Chorus]
Regarde mes yeux, je suis sincère
On peut traverser cette nuit d'hiver

[Chorus]
Pardonne-moi, danse avec moi
Le rythme efface le froid
Pardonne-moi, serre-moi fort
On reconstruit le décor

[Bridge]
Plus de fierté, juste la vérité
Notre histoire mérite d'être sauvée

[Chorus]
Pardonne-moi, danse avec moi
Le rythme efface le froid
Pardonne-moi, serre-moi fort
On reconstruit le décor

[Outro]
Cœur repentant, amour géant
Pardonne-moi, c'est important
